purpose: Define the immutable audit needed to derive a future T2 decision universe from a frozen U0 population without manual nomination or convenience bias. It is not a T2 universe, selection, allocation or action.

exception_policy.default: Manual inclusion, exclusion, substitution or class bypass is prohibited.
exception_policy.permitted_exception: Only a documented operational correction may be proposed. It requires an immutable exception ID, reason, source evidence, independent R0/R1/risk approval and a new freeze record.
exception_policy.disclosure: Every exception is reported in the T2 audit output and cannot be hidden in a generic notes field.

coverage_scope_rule.open_universe_label: A result may use an open domestic multi-asset label only when every in-scope U0 class has a reconciled population and an accepted data/replay module, or is explicitly out of scope with a dated independently approved reason.
coverage_scope_rule.restricted_label: If any in-scope class lacks a population, data module or protocol module, the run must be labeled coverage-restricted by included and omitted class. It cannot imply that omitted classes were economically rejected.
coverage_scope_rule.t2_class_gate: No item may appear in T2 unless its parent U0 class has an accepted module and the item-level audit passes the frozen rule.

acceptance_tests: U0 snapshot hash and source manifests resolve and class counts reconcile.
Every T2 item maps to exactly one U0 parent_class_id and U0 membership key.
Every U0 item has an inclusion/exclusion/unfinished status; no silent disappearance.
Every inclusion/exclusion uses a pre-frozen rule ID; overrides resolve to reviewed exception IDs.
Per-class data/protocol module state is explicit and drives coverage label.
Independent reviewer can reproduce T2 from the U0 snapshot and item audit.
pass_threshold: 0 unmapped T2 item, 0 silent U0 omission, 0 manual nomination, 0 unresolved exception and 0 open-universe label where coverage is restricted.
